hook.evidence: 'This drop could outlive you.' - concrete image (the falling drop) plus a personal stake; it could not open another video.

structure.evidence: Hook -> tomb proof -> three mechanisms (dry, peroxide, acid) -> 'Dry. Acidic. Self-disinfecting.' -> twist payoff 'the only thing that ruins honey... is water' in the last 2 lines; the drop-in-tea visual loops back to the opening drop.

clarity.evidence: Short, one-idea sentences and 'honey drinks them dry' is retellable; held from 5 because 'Bees add glucose oxidase' drops an unexplained term (never called an enzyme) on a listener.

pace.evidence: 69 spoken words / 30 s = 2.30 wps (lower edge of 2.3-2.8); every sentence is one breath ('Dry. Acidic. Self-disinfecting.'); each beat has a [VISUAL] cue.

accuracy.evidence: Tomb claim marked '[reported claim; flagged for source check]'; water and enzyme claims sourced (USDA FoodData, J. Apic. Res. review); but 'around pH 3.9' has no source tag and 'the only thing that ruins honey... is water' slightly overstates.

voice.evidence: Ownable, specific wording: 'This drop could outlive you', 'honey drinks them dry', the three-word chant 'Dry. Acidic. Self-disinfecting.'

notes: Pace sits right at the 2.3 floor.
